title: Beatrix and the Locker
author: Orsen Eriksen
blurb: Odile Winterbourne, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before prom.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
